record.question: Digital transformation in pharmacy using mHealth includes all of the following innovative measures EXCEPT:
record.explanation: Answer D: Use of Automated Dispensing Cabinets (ADCs). Mobile health includes smartphone apps, teleconsultation, and SMS reminders. Automated dispensing cabinets are fixed/institutional pharmacy automation, not mHealth. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241514849. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
